title: Twilight of the Velocipede: Typesetting Races Before the Age of Linotype
summary: A historical essay exploring the competitive world of manual typesetting races before the Linotype machine revolutionized printing in the late 19th century, examining how typesetters competed against each other and early mechanical devices in speed and precision.
problem_solved: Documents the evolution from manual typesetting labor to mechanical automation, preserving knowledge of a forgotten era when 'racing' the velocipede (an early term for racing against machines) was a serious professional pursuit.
why_valuable: Provides fascinating historical insight into pre-industrial printing technology and the human element of craftsmanship that was eventually replaced by industrial automation.
